messages:
Priya: Noticed p99 jump on latency dashboard for /v1/embeddings at 08:45. p50 looks stable, p95 slight uptick, p99 huge. Anybody touched routing or quota rules?
Evan: I pushed an emergency fallback weight tweak at 08:44 to drain a problematic pool. It routed ~18% of traffic to an alternate proxy.
Lena: Can you share the dashboard query? Want to reproduce.
Priya: The widget query is: `SELECT p50(lat_ms), p95(lat_ms), p99(lat_ms) FROM latency WHERE endpoint='/v1/embeddings' AND env='prod' GROUP BY sample_origin, route` window=30m.
Ravi: Interesting: fallback-proxy has a much heavier tail; looks like tokenization + remote-cache-miss. Also, we aggregate percentiles from t-digests at service-level which can hide origin composition shifts.
Evan: Is the ask to break down percentiles by origin or to annotate the chart with routing events?
Priya: Both. When an operator sees a p99 jump, we should show whether it's due to origin mix shift. Right now the dashboard only shows combined pXX and a single sparkline.
Lena: UX idea: add an "attribution mode" which overlays per-origin percentile lines (dashed) and shows a stacked legend with percentages. Also a toggle to switch to histogram view so you can visually see tail mass.
Ravi: We should be careful: switching to per-origin percentiles and excluding some origins will change SLO math. SLOs are defined on user-visible latency (all origins). We can expose a derived view `p99_attribution_by_origin` but the canonical SLO metric remains p99_all.
Evan: Another concern: our rollup pipeline compresses histograms. If we store raw histograms for the last 1h we can recompute accurate percentiles per-origin instead of merging t-digests across services. That solves aggregation artifacts. Costs some storage/compute but only for short windows.
Priya: Good trade-off. For quick wins: 1) dashboard event overlays for routing policy changes 2) legend shows sample_origin percentages 3) attribution mode for per-origin p50/p95/p99 4) add a "histogram recompute" button to recalc percentiles for the selected window
Lena: I can prototype the UI: stacked origin badges, dashed origin percentiles, and a small delta tile: `p99 delta by origin: fallback +420ms (18% traffic)`
Ravi: I'll add telemetry tests: ensure every path sets `sample_origin` and that proxies preserve tag through retries. Also add an integration test that simulates 20% fallback and verifies recomputed p99 matches expectations within noise.
Evan: One small API tweak: add `?origin_breakdown=true` to the backend query so dashboards can request per-origin aggregates in a single call. Example: `/api/metrics?endpoint=/v1/embeddings&window=30m&origin_breakdown=true`. It returns an array of origin->histogram buckets.
Priya: Make sure we don't silently change SLO evaluation. The UI must show a clear marker "Derived view: not your SLO metric" when viewing attribution.
deploy-bot: config-change 2026-03-22T08:44Z: routing-weight-adjustment deployed (id: rw-20260322-8)
Evan: I'll open the doc/mini-RFC with implementation plan: backend storage for short-window histograms, new API param, dashboard UI mocks, and integration tests.
Lena: Will attach mocks to the RFC by EOD.
Ravi: I'll own the telemetry validation and the integration test harness.
Priya: Thanks all. Let's triage this into a 2-week epic: quick overlays + legend (week 1), recompute histograms + attribution API (week 2). Sync tomorrow 9:30 to kick off.
